response.original_title: [Quick-Support] Can You Add a Passenger to a Princess Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, you can add a passenger to an existing Princess Cruise by calling Princess Customer Service directly at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or contacting your travel advisor,+1-866-254-7549 as additions cannot be processed online. Key Requirements & Rules Cabin Capacity: Your current stateroom must have the physical and legal capacity to hold an extra guest +1-866-254-7549 (e.g., upper pullmans or a sofa bed). Ship & Lifeboat Limits: The total ship occupancy or lifeboat section must not be sold out.Pricing Updates: +1-866-254-7549 Adding a guest requires re-pricing the cabin at current prevailing rates rather than your original booking rate. Required Information: Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and passport details ready when you call +1-866-254-7549.
